label: D2 after a1 led rarely to S2, following an unrewarded previous trial
explanation: Fires only at D2, and only when the agent chose a1 and the rare transition took it to S2 (in_action==1, in_state==2). That rule covers 100% of activations but only 32% of such steps fire. Requiring that the previous trial was unrewarded (prev_reward==0, which the agent saw at this trial s D1) raises precision to 0.65 and keeps 84% of activation mass (dev F1 0.67). Everything here is observed at D2, so no future variables are used. Magnitude is largest when the agent has kept choosing a1 through several unrewarded trials and the good state has switched to S2, meaning its preference for a1 is weak or wrong. It is weak (0.01-0.2 of max) after rewarded a1 trials while S1 is still good. Firing also drops off late in the episode (almost none after trial 90); adding ep_trial<80 gives F1 0.71, but that was left out of the recorded rule as less coherent. It never fires at D1 or GO, after a2, on common transitions, or when a1 reaches S1.
